verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, so documenting the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions the rule, parole, or any qualifying-investment thresholds. The general investors-and-entrepreneurs page and the J-1 Incubator founder pathway are adjacent offerings and do not count as the requested pathway.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
